skills.skill: Multiply a two- or three-digit whole number by a one-digit number or by 10, 100, 1000

misconceptions.pattern: Multiplies only the ones digit of the multi-digit number and ignores the tens/hundreds (e.g. 28 × 5 answered 40 instead of 140), not distributing across every place.

strategies.intent: Multiply each place of the larger number by the one-digit factor (expanded form / partial products), then add the parts; for ×10/100/1000 shift every digit up and fill with zeros.
